prompt: Create one production game UI asset: a transparent PNG sprite atlas of FOUR distinct veteran military training insignia for an original Civilization-inspired historical strategy game. One atlas, square 2-by-2 equal grid, generous transparent gutters and no frames dividing cells. Every insignia precisely centered in its quarter; equal visual size approximately 65% of cell width. TOP LEFT: offensive training, crossed antique steel swords over a warm bronze sunburst. TOP RIGHT: defensive bastion training, sturdy bronze shield with a tiny crenellated tower relief. BOTTOM LEFT: terrain training, embossed emerald green oak leaves with a winding mountain path in aged brass. BOTTOM RIGHT: battlefield medical preparation, rolled linen bandages and a small green medicinal sprig over bronze, NO red cross or real-world protected emblem. Cohesive restrained painterly 3D inventory icon style, finely modeled warm worn brass and steel, small readable silhouettes, soft upper-left natural light, muted teal/gold palette compatible with dark historical-game menus. Front-facing relief medals with no dangling ribbon. No words, numbers, borders, people, modern logos, background scenery, or ground plane. Truly transparent background and no cast shadow outside each insignia. Output one atlas only, all four quadrants fully separated.
